reports.title: Silicon Motion Announces Results for the Quarterly Period Ended September 30, 2026

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: “The NAND industry is undergoing significant change. Growing demand for enterprise and AI storage is absorbing a larger share of industry supply and pushing NAND flash prices higher. In response, NAND manufacturers are increasingly prioritizing high-capacity enterprise SSDs and pulling back from certain consumer-oriented segments, including PCs, mobile devices, IoT, automotive and enterprise boot drives. We believe this shift creates a meaningful opportunity for our products in these segments. Our proprietary controller technology and nearly two decades of NAND ecosystem relationships, together with our investments in eMMC and UFS solutions, 6nm PCIe Gen 5 edge SSD controllers, 4nm PCIe Gen 6 MonTitan enterprise and AI SSD controllers, and our Ferri and boot drive product families, position us to address demand across AI data center, AI server, edge AI and physical AI applications.”

“While rising memory costs have created pricing pressure in some consumer device segments, our enterprise and Ferri customers have generally prioritized supply assurance over price. As our revenue mix continues to shift toward enterprise and AI applications, our backlog and customer forecasts support our expectation of continued growth. Based on results to date and current visibility, we believe we are on track to deliver record annual revenue in 2026, representing more than 100% growth over the prior year, with our enterprise and AI product families still in the early stages of revenue contribution,” said Mr. Kou.
